description: Implementation of DeviceProvisionService for handling device provisioning, including X509 certificate chain provisioning, device creation, and event logging within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DeviceProvisionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of device provisioning logic, including handling X509 certificates, device creation, and event notification within Thingsboard.

methods.name: provisionDeviceViaX509Chain
methods.description: Handles provisioning of a device via X509 certificate chain, creating or updating device credentials as needed.

methods.name: provisionDevice
methods.description: Main method for provisioning a device based on provided credentials and device profile.

methods.name: processProvision
methods.description: Processes the provisioning state of a device, updating attributes and notifying the rule engine.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device based on the provisioning request and profile.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends provisioning event notifications to the rule engine and logs actions.

methods.name: processCreateDevice
methods.description: Handles the actual creation of a device, including saving attributes and notifying rule engine.

methods.name: updateDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Updates device credentials with new certificate data.

methods.name: saveProvisionStateAttribute
methods.description: Saves the device's provisioning state attribute.

methods.name: getDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves device credentials for a given device.

methods.name: pushProvisionEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes a provisioning event message to the rule engine.

methods.name: pushDeviceCreatedEventToRuleEngine
methods.description: Pushes a device creation event to the rule engine.

methods.name: sendToRuleEngine
methods.description: Sends a message to the rule engine via the message producer.

methods.name: createTbMsgMetaData
methods.description: Creates message metadata for rule engine messages.

methods.name: logAction
methods.description: Logs provisioning actions for audit purposes.

methods.name: getCNFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts the Common Name (CN) from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: extractDeviceNameFromCNByRegEx
methods.description: Extracts device name from CN using regex pattern.
